gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p7) prints major 'Debt Service' and 'Aquatic Center' columns with no schedule: Debt Service Property 36 + Sales 490,199 + Interest income 18,369 = Total revenues 508,604; Aquatic Center Sales 612,749 + Interest income 28,269 = 641,018; together 1,149,622. (2) Different basis: Street and Economic Development detail come from budgetary-basis comparison schedules; Note A (p16) prints Street budgetary 1,124,668 + cash to accrual 984 = GAAP 1,125,652 and Economic Development budgetary 110,407 + (11,784) = GAAP 98,623 (General 5,209,557 and Capital Projects 526,706 detail already equal the GAAP column; nonmajor 321,602 equals the Other Governmental Funds column). Arithmetic: 7,292,940 + 1,149,622 = 8,442,562; 8,442,562 + 984 - 11,784 = 8,431,762 = statement Total revenues (p7). After the added lines the remaining 10,800 (schedule above) is the printed budget-to-GAAP difference; no further fix.

gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns (p7): Debt Service General government 60 + Principal payments on debt 345,000 + Interest on long-term debt 7,237 = Total expenditures 352,297; Aquatic Center Environment and leisure 2,567 + Principal payments on debt 400,000 + Interest on long-term debt 10,280 = 412,847; together 765,144. (2) Different basis (Note A, p16): Street budgetary 1,510,811 + (2,571) = GAAP 1,508,240; Capital Projects budgetary 777,400 + 2,056 = GAAP 779,456; Economic Development budgetary 25,962 + 32,176 = GAAP 58,138 (General 4,794,417 and nonmajor 383,150 detail already equal the statement columns). Arithmetic: 7,491,740 + 765,144 = 8,256,884; 8,256,884 - 2,571 + 2,056 + 32,176 = 8,288,545 = statement Total expenditures (p7). After the added lines the remaining 31,661 (schedule short) is the printed budget-to-GAAP difference; no further fix.

gaps.explanation: The Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (p19, Total column) prints Transfers in 100,000 (Fire department) and Transfers out (851,015) (Administrative 834,015, Airport 8,500, Parks and Cemetery 8,500), net (751,015). The governmental funds statement (p6) prints the General Fund net of these intra-fund department transfers: Transfers in -, Transfers out (751,015). Detail transfers in 100,000 + Street 525,000 + Capital Projects 469,450 + Other Governmental 32,065 = 1,126,515 vs statement 1,026,515 (p7): the 100,000 is the intra-General Fund department transfer recorded gross. No fix.

Same intra-General Fund department transfer: detail transfers out 851,015 (p19) + Street 8,500 + Other Governmental 5,000 = 864,515 vs statement (764,515) (p7), whose General column prints (751,015) = 851,015 - 100,000. The 100,000 is grossed in the department schedule and netted on the statement. No fix.
